name: The English Book Depot
description: An iconic Bookstore with a cozy café tucked in the back. Smells of fresh paper and dark roast coffee. Ideal for losing an afternoon in a novel.
recommendation: Try the Hibiscus Iced Tea and sit by the window shelf.

name: Chai Under the Pines
description: A quiet wooden stall serving steaming hot ginger chai in clay cups (kulhads). Surrounded by towering pines and cool mountain breezes.
recommendation: Ginger Cardamom Chai + Bun Makhan toasted over hot coals.

name: Canal Road Trail
description: A leafy path running alongside the old irrigation canals. Beautifully quiet during light showers with view of distant green ridges.
recommendation: Go around 5 PM just as the streetlights begin to flicker on.

name: Ellora's Melting Moments
description: An old school bakery from the Ruskin Bond era. Cozy, nostalgic, and filled with the scent of vanilla essence and butter cream.
recommendation: Famous Butter Toffees (Stick Jaws) and Plum Cake.

name: FRI Grounds
description: Colossal Roman-style brick campus surrounded by dense botanical gardens. A massive quiet space to sketch, walk, or just sit under ancient trees.
recommendation: Carry a notebook and walk down the main tree-lined boulevard.

name: Synergy Hospital Pharmacy
description: A well-stocked 24/7 medical store and reliable clinic. Keep this address saved in your phone notes. Good to know it's always open.
